triage.verifier_justification: The only meaning change in ch62 is the Brazil IEEPA carve-out condition in both `ieepa_component_rate` and `ieepa_component_rate_with_declared_exceptions`, which moves from the witness fixture flag `entry_is_line_b` to the membership predicate `entry_is_section_232_aluminum`; the rest of the diff (steel `source:` string and proof-atom citation paths `9903.81.87/.88` → `9903.82.02`) leaves rate `'0.50'`, formula, and `effective_from: '2026-02-15'` untouched and is provenance-only. Both the pre and post files carry the same proof atom for that branch — `excerpt: The additional duties imposed by heading 9903.01.77 shall not apply to products of aluminum provided for in heading 9903.85.02.` (pre line 2125) — so the encoding asserted an aluminum-membership carve-out while conditioning it on "is this the witness's exemplar line b," a predicate with no basis in the cited note; the fix re-grounds the condition on the membership the note names, which is the untraceable_branch pattern rather than a missing clause, a scope swap, or inverted logic. The identifiers are not aliases: post-fix `entry_is_line_b` still lives in the same module as `entry_is_reciprocal_metals_excluded`'s formula, so the branch really evaluates differently. I hold the kind but lower confidence slightly because the commit body is empty and the project frames the work as "decoupling," so the pre-state is arguably generator scaffolding rather than an asserted reading of the note.
